messages:
Ava: Quick kickoff — activation pulse for Tuesday webinar + free-credit nudge. Goal: bump first-run activation ~12% and get ~100 prompt-template trials. Thinking cadence + routing + A/B. Who wants what?
Miguel: Love it. Proposed cadence: pre-webinar email (48h), in-webinar CTA, immediate 24h follow-up, then 3-day drip. Nudge amount: 50 credits for webinar signups.
Priya: +1. Let's A/B test 'credit + template attached' vs 'credit only'. Primary metrics: redemption rate, 7-day activation, and prompt-template open rate.
Jun: ops-bot created draft campaign: /campaigns/activation-pulse-v1 — includes triggers and webhook placeholders. Can wire routing to signup events.
Ava: @Miguel can you draft the landing microcopy? Keep CTAs very explicit: "Try a template with 50 credits" and add examples for devs.
Miguel: Yep. Drafting now. For routing: if user signs up within 48h of webinar time, tag = webinar_cohort, auto-credit 50 via billing API. Want fallback logic if billing call fails?
Jun: fallback = queue job + email to ops. Also add metric event: credit_grant_attempt and credit_grant_success for observability.
Priya: For the A/B, randomize at signup and persist experiment key. We'll need to surface which cohort in analytics. Also create a tiny eval: seed 20 prompts and track template->completion usage.
Ava: Good call. Keep variant names short: A = credit+template, B = credit-only. Priya own eval, Miguel own CTA + landing, Jun own infra + webhook.
Miguel: Microcopy idea for in-webinar CTA: "Get 50 credits + starter prompt pack — instant in your dashboard." Short, no extra clicks.
Priya: Suggested subject lines for pre-email: 1) "Reserve your seat + get 50 credits" 2) "Webinar tomorrow — try Redwood with 50 credits" — we'll test subject line open delta.
Ava: Nice. Also want an internal benchmark narrative for the postmortem: measure conversion funnel at each touchpoint and estimated unit cost per activated user. Capture baseline this week.
Jun: Ops checklist: webhook test, idempotency, rate-limit handling, retry queue, and a runbook for manual grant. I'll add to the campaign doc.
Ava: Timing: soft launch to 10% of registrants tomorrow AM, then ramp if no infra issues. Sync owners on 10am stand.
Miguel: I'll push landing + CTA by EOD.
Priya: Experiment config sent to analytics — tracking keys + dashboard widgets.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: check campaign health at +2h and +24h after launch.
Ava: Thanks all — owners locked. We'll iterate messaging after first 24h signals. :sparkles:
